title: When BTC dips and MMT rockets
content:
Bitcoin: “I’m just a little bruised, 2.3% down.”
MMT: “Hold my coffee, I’m up 58.5% and screaming ‘to the moon!’" 
Trader at 3 AM: “Did I just miss the launch or the crash?"
lesson: Always set a stop‑loss before you start chasing the hype train.
question: Who else was glued to the 1‑minute chart watching MMT’s fireworks? Be honest 👇
